# FLUX 3 edit chain

**Workflow:** [`flux3/flux3-edit-chain.json`](../flux3/flux3-edit-chain.json)

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Family | `flux3` |
| Nodes | 13 |
| Links | 11 |
| Paid API calls per run | **3** |

---

Generate, then edit, then edit again — each stage takes the previous result as `input_image`, so you refine one image a step at a time and only pay for the step you changed.

Each stage is a group. ComfyUI only re-runs a node whose inputs changed, and every FLUX 3 node here has a **fixed** `variation`, so editing **Edit 2**'s text re-runs Edit 2 alone; stages 1 and Edit 1 come from cache for free. Bump a stage's `variation` to re-roll just that stage (and everything after it).

**Fast Groups Bypasser** (rgthree) toggles the edit stages. A bypassed stage makes no call and hands its input image straight on, so the chain always ends at the last active stage: bypass both edits while you settle the base image, or bypass just Edit 1 to apply Edit 2 to the base directly. Bypass rather than mute — a muted Edit 1 would leave Edit 2 with no image, and it would quietly run as text-to-image.

The base prompt is the **Shared Prompt**; each edit's instruction is a core **Text (Multiline)** node, so the instructions sit in plain view beside the stage they drive. `resolution` on the edits is **match_input**, so the size never drifts across the chain.

**Image Comparer** shows base vs final; each stage also has a preview so you can see where a change crept in.

### Needs
[rgthree-comfy](https://github.com/rgthree/rgthree-comfy). **Manager → Install Missing Custom Nodes** finds it if the graph loads with red nodes.

## The prompt lives in one node

The **Shared Prompt** node feeds every FLUX 3 `prompt` in this graph, so there is one
place to edit it. It emits a plain string, **not** a list, so each node it feeds still runs once.
